courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 地下車站活塞風控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「步道距離與協助時間」與「下車匯流區密度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；地下車站活塞風控制的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Walkway distance and assistance time" and "Density in alighting merge areas" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Piston-wind control in underground stations must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦隧道步道連續性照明與協助疏散；地下車站活塞風控制則以列車活塞效應旁通開口與壓力瞬變為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tunnel-walkway continuity lighting and assisted evacuation; Piston-wind control in underground stations centres on train piston effects bypass openings and pressure transients, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「步道距離與協助時間」與「列車誘導壓力量級」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到地下車站活塞風控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「壓力量測誤差合成」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Walkway distance and assistance time” and “Scale of train-induced pressure”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Piston-wind control in underground stations, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Combining pressure measurement uncertainty", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Maintenance-depot workflow planning, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鐵路隧道疏散步道
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1991 年一九八五年緊急整備指南於該年重印。；2015 年地下車站旅客流研究報告於該年出版。；2025 年臺灣鐵道車站概念設計指引函頒。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對隧道步道連續性照明與協助疏散而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用步道局部有效淨寬及協助需求路徑案例連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 1991: The rail-transit emergency guide originally published in nineteen eighty-five was reprinted. 2015: A study of underground-station passenger flow was published. 2025: Taiwan issued guidance for conceptual railway-station design. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For tunnel-walkway continuity lighting and assisted evacuation, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through local effective walkway width and route cases for assistance needs. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
